author: lightclient
content: for 8130, you have to register your authenticators with they keystore. for 8141 you need to update your wallet code. IMO those are pretty similar operations

author: donnoh
content: but are they? what if a smart wallet is not upgradable but allows arbitrary calls. works with 8130 but not 8141

author: lightclient
content: if a smart wallet isn't upgradable yes, they wouldn't be able to use 8141 as written. that is a very small percentage of all accounts though

author: donnoh
content: one argument could be that if a smart wallet is not upgradable then it was intended not to have different authentication methods
